components.name: Actual Product Evidence Frame
components.description: Homepage signature: imagegen-retouched real populated demo-panel capture, disclosed identity cleanup, sample-data caption, container-width rounded frame and CSS excerpt. Actual PNG is 1507 × 1044 and served unoptimized. Desktop photo bleeds right and extends 112px behind this frame; approved full flow remains intact.

narrative.overview:
The implemented identity pairs the warmth of an architectural publication with the precision of a financial workspace. Parchment surfaces, copper actions, charcoal identity bands and original courtyard/shared-space photography make property management feel grounded in the places people live. Dark mode translates the same roles into charcoal surfaces and apricot actions.

Marketing uses compact editorial sections, a Manrope homepage headline with a copper true-italic serif companion, and actual populated product evidence. Operational screens keep compact Manrope typography, readable labels and comparable figures. Shared color roles connect both surfaces without imposing a landing-page composition on the panel. Brand strings remain centralized in `packages/config/src/site.ts`; Yönetimcell is the currently configured placeholder, and Vekil is not a shipped rebrand.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, restrained surfaces with hairline divisions.
Editorial marketing headings; practical sans forms and tables.
Semantic light/dark themes and meaningful financial status colors.
Real product captures with disclosed image retouch and sample-data captions, interactive illustrations with example labels, and traceable architectural imagery.

rules.name: Semantic Role
rules.body: Component JSX uses `bg-canvas`, `text-fg`, `border-border`, `bg-primary` and related roles. Hex values and raw Tailwind color utilities belong outside component JSX; do not add `dark:` color pairs. Theme mapping remains centralized under `data-theme`.

dos: **Do** use the executable semantic CSS tokens and their theme pairs; refresh this document when those sources change.
**Do** keep serif editorial scale in marketing and compact Manrope in operational screens.
**Do** preserve financial status semantics, chart-series identity, legends and table alternatives.
**Do** retain visible focus, readable long labels, reduced-motion support, responsive records and user density/font preferences.
**Do** read brand names from configuration; disclose retouched product captures and caption them with their sample-data context and label interactive or portfolio illustrations as examples.
donts: **Don't** introduce raw color utilities, inline hex color values or `dark:` color pairs in component JSX.
**Don't** recolor every chart copper, or prohibit chart blue because blue is no longer the primary brand action.
**Don't** impose marketing 6px container overrides, display font sizes or a page-specific hero arrangement on the panel.
**Don't** replace real interactions with a raster, invent customer claims, or turn illustrative controls into feature promises.
**Don't** add heavy decorative shadows, gradient headline text, nested empty cards or perpetual motion to express this warm identity.
